content: As an EV driver, this has been the most useful app for finding chargers. Not only is it useful for planning longer trips, but also for locating locally available chargers. I don't have the luxury of being able to charge at home or work, so being able to see what charges are available near me is a godsend. Especially since the charger types I'm limited to are few-and-far between in an area with many other EVs. It's also immensely helpful having current updates and feedback from other EV drivers!
developer_reply: This is so awesome to hear and happy to know you are pleased with the service and features PlugShare has to offer. Thanks for your 5 star review and hope you continue to have happy charging experiences!
